messages:
sam (partnerships): Hey @ying — for the new cost model we need a compact supply snapshot from Nebula: per-SKU spot/reserved rates, commit buckets, eviction cadence (corr window), and any promo credits you plan for marketplace launches. Can you drop a CSV by EOD?
ying (nebula): Yep. Prefer a single CSV with per-region rows. Do you want p50/p95 spot or just raw spot samples?
kyle (finance): p50 and p95 are super helpful. If you can attach a 7-day hourly sample link for volatility that's even better.
ingrid (marketplace): Also include marketplace_fee_pct and whether SKU is eligible for "featured" listing (boolean). If you expect joint announcement credits, add announce_credit_usd field.
sam (partnerships): Suggested header: sku,region,spot_usd_hr,median_spot_usd_hr,p95_spot_usd_hr,reserved_usd_hr,commit_hours,commit_label,eviction_corr_tag,eviction_prob_hour,preempt_notice_mins,marketplace_fee_pct,announce_credit_usd,featured_listing,planned_ramp_dates,notes
ying (nebula): Sample rows so you know format:
NEB-A100,nebula,us-east-1,0.78,0.72,0.95,0.50,720,3mo,SHORT,0.003,20,0.06,250,TRUE,2026-06-01->200;2026-07-01->400,"nightly grace pool"
NEB-A100,nebula,eu-west-1,0.83,0.77,1.05,0.55,8760,12mo,LONG,0.011,10,0.08,0,TRUE,2026-09-01->1000,"higher maintenance windows"
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/nebula/1735000000_snapshot_v1.csv — validating... parsed 14 SKUs, warnings: 1 SKU missing median_spot, using 30d fallback.
kyle (finance): Thanks. We'll ingest and run a short sensitivity sweep (commit tenor / marketplace fee / featured lift). If you can follow up with exit_penalty_pct for reserved commitments that'd be helpful.
ying (nebula): Will add exit_penalty_pct and a small sample timeseries manifest in v2. Also open to a quick onboarding call to automate future feeds.
sam (partnerships): Great — plan to review Fri 9:30. Invite to follow. Thanks all!
